name: Shadow
caption: A white-robed entrant for the JCWF's Japanese World Championship, who in a September 1994 interview waved off Doctor Feelgood and Punjab the Mad Arab and challenged the first to accept.

identity.note: Shares a bare ring name with other Shadow records, among them T-Shadow of FoB (2005), who is billed Shadow beside Gifted a decade later in a different federation. Nothing in either record connects them; filed distinct.
